_description: v7 baseline: H1 + H4 + H5 permanently integrated. H1 = deployment floor (floor_n: 2). H4 = momentum reweight (proximity 0.45 / momentum 0.55). H5 = shorter PEAD hold (pead_max_hold_days: 10). Copy and modify for hypothesis testing.
_baseline: v6 had H1+H4. v7 adds H5: pead_max_hold_days 15->10.
_h1_integrated: H1 passed Tier 1. Deployment floor prevents over-deployment in bad regimes.
_h4_integrated: H4 passed Tier 2. Jan-Mar +31.9% / Jul-Sep +6.9%. Momentum reweight 0.45/0.55 selects stronger drift candidates, improves bad-regime WR +3.2pp.
_h5_integrated: H5 passed Tier 2. Jan-Mar +43.7% (+$21,838, WR 60.0%, R:R 2.37) / Jul-Sep +15.9% (+$9,029, WR 47.8%, R:R 2.71). Shorter hold cuts losers before extension, winners complete PEAD drift within 10d. Biggest single improvement of testing cycle.
notes: v6 changes from v5: universe.score_weight_proximity 0.60->0.45, score_weight_momentum 0.40->0.55 (H4).
All other parameters unchanged from v4 baseline_default.json.
